# Tinydo

> Tinydo is an ADHD-friendly planner and focus app for iPhone and iPad. Tell Tiny what's going on and AI breaks it into tiny steps; a visual timer, daily routines, medication and water reminders, focus sounds and gentle follow-ups help you get it done. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Tinydo (App Store name: "Tinydo: ADHD Planner & Focus") is an iPhone and iPad app made by Gokche Tech, an independent developer in Turkey. It is free to download; using it requires a Tinydo Pro subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly, no free plan), and the monthly plan has a 3-day free trial for new subscribers. Tell Tiny is an ongoing chat with Tiny. It is a planning and focus companion, not a medical app.

Key facts:

- What it is: An ADHD-friendly planner and focus app with AI task breakdown, a visual timer, routines, medication reminders, focus sounds and gentle follow-ups.
- Who it’s for: People with ADHD (no diagnosis needed), students, parents and anyone who procrastinates or struggles to start.
- Devices: iPhone and iPad with iOS or iPadOS 18 or later. Syncs through your private iCloud. There is no Android version.
- Price: Free to download. Using the app requires a Tinydo Pro subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly); there is no free plan. The monthly plan includes a 3-day free trial for new subscribers.
- Privacy: No account, no ads, no tracking. The AI is used only if you allow it.
- Languages: 30, including English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Turkish, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.
- Made by: Gokche Tech, an independent developer in Turkey.
